Method of Attack: Installed Weave Scope open-source tool to gain full control of victim’s cloud infrastructure without deploying malicious code
Created clean Ubuntu container via exposed Docker API to mount on victim server and access host files
Set up local user 'hilde' with elevated privileges to connect via SSH
Connected to Weave Scope dashboard via HTTP on port 4040 to take control
Attack Vector: Accessible Weave Scope dashboard port 4040 from outside network
Indicators of Compromise: Weave Scope dashboard accessible on port 4040
Cryptomining worm stealing AWS credentials and configuration files
